sessions.phase_label: Initial scope exploration and writing test

requirements.title: Pre-project Writing Test
requirements.definition: Complete the independently requested writing test and provide a professional assessment of the proposed second-edition revisions.
requirements.boundary_note: This is retained because the test document was an independently requested deliverable; routine later editorial review is not part of this Requirement.

requirements.title: Existing Question Set Curation
requirements.definition: Review all 250 existing questions and recommend removals, merges, additions, category changes, or rephrasing so the question set reflects current leadership-interview practice.
requirements.boundary_note: Suggestion-mode editing, rationale comments for removals, and editorial approval are attributes of the curation workflow; developing the answer content is independently testable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Layered Answer Structure
requirements.definition: Develop answers using mandatory framing guidance and a sample answer, with interviewer intent and common mistakes added where applicable and answer frameworks integrated into framing guidance.
requirements.boundary_note: The answer layers are attributes of one answer-format mechanism; STAR and similar frameworks are integrated into framing guidance rather than treated as separate deliverables.

requirements.title: Leadership Pre-interview Preparation Chapter
requirements.definition: Author a concise theory-focused pre-interview preparation chapter tailored to experienced and first-time leadership candidates rather than basic interview preparation.
requirements.boundary_note: This chapter has its own subject matter and acceptance criteria and can be revised independently of the other four new chapters.

requirements.title: AI Interview Preparation Chapter
requirements.definition: Author a concise chapter explaining how leadership candidates can use AI prompts, techniques, and tools for interview preparation.
requirements.boundary_note: The client explicitly identified this as a mandatory and uniquely valuable chapter, independent of the other new chapters.

requirements.title: Questions Candidates Can Ask the Interviewer
requirements.definition: Author a question-and-answer chapter covering useful questions leadership candidates can ask an interviewer.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently authored Q&A chapter; its question count is flexible within the overall manuscript word budget.

requirements.title: First-time Leader Interview Questions Chapter
requirements.definition: Author a question-and-answer chapter specifically for candidates transitioning into leadership roles for the first time.
requirements.boundary_note: The first-time-leader audience has distinct questions and acceptance criteria and should not be merged with general or remote-leadership content.

requirements.title: Remote and Hybrid Leadership Questions Chapter
requirements.definition: Author a question-and-answer chapter addressing leadership interviews for remote and hybrid work roles.
requirements.boundary_note: Remote and hybrid leadership is a distinct interview context that can be authored, reviewed, or fail independently of the other new chapters.

requirements.title: Global Interview Perspective
requirements.definition: Frame the book primarily for US and Indian audiences while weaving relevant country and market differences throughout the existing and new content, supported by a brief introductory note.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a cross-cutting content behavior rather than a standalone country chapter; UK and UAE coverage was suggested, but the clearly established core focus is the US and India.

requirements.title: Hybrid Companion Resources
requirements.definition: Produce practical online companion resources for the book, with finished assets where feasible, complete templates, and scripts for videos that the publisher will record.
requirements.boundary_note: The companion resources are independently required deliverables rather than testing or general project process; individual examples remain options within this resource package.

requirements.title: Manuscript Word Budget
requirements.definition: Keep the complete second-edition manuscript at or below 50,000 words, with approximately 13,000 words available for revisions and additions beyond the roughly 37,000-word first edition.
requirements.boundary_note: The 50,000-word total cap and corrected 13,000-word addition figure are coupled dimensions of one manuscript word-budget constraint.

requirements.title: Original Authorship and Limited AI Assistance
requirements.definition: Ensure the submitted manuscript reflects the freelancer's original analysis, writing, and professional judgment, using AI only for permitted supporting activities such as research, outlining, grammar, or editorial assistance.
requirements.boundary_note: The first visible evidence is the client's termination message quoting the contract condition and reporting violations; no earlier introduction should be fabricated.

requirements.title: Project Delivery Timeline
requirements.definition: Complete the scoped project in approximately one month, with August 20, 2026 as the tentative delivery target subject to review when the contract starts.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the explicit bounded delivery obligation; compensation, contract signature mechanics, and routine scheduling administration are excluded.
